text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Today,
the Chan-me Doll has something to say to you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Hello~.
It's time for the Chan-Mar Doll Health Class~.
Today's theme is: [Beware of Overworking]~!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Not only is there a risk of injury, but she might also lose motivation, so you need to be careful."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Chan needs to be careful too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Aston Machan seems to still be fatigued
from the race. Let's reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
